checklist_role: Future capture-packet validation rules. Static checklist only; no capture performed.
input_packet_required_files: quality-comparison-report.* for same pair_id before token savings can be allowed
validation_order: Validate adaptive user-local/target refs and fresh-load locator refs.
Validate pair integrity: same host, prompt hash, method, evidence class, target locator mode except adaptive variable, tokenizer/accounting, redaction.
Validate token accounting report fields and repeated-run/variance policy.
Validate quality non-regression prerequisite for the same pair_id.
Keep token_savings_claim_allowed=false unless every prior gate is PASS.

validation_rules.check: baseline.host.* equals adaptive.host.* for host_name, host_type, host_runtime_surface, host_runtime_version, adapter_version, host_entrypoint and live_scope
scenario_id, pair_id, canonical_prompt_text_sha256, task_id, expected_answer_contract_ref, prompt_privacy_class and source_split_id match
method_id, debug_enabled, invocation_options_hash_sha256 and counted pipeline step match
evidence_classification and live_scope match; non-live helper/dashboard/API/handler evidence cannot be upgraded into live host savings
accounting_version, tokenizer_name, tokenizer_version, tokenizer_accounting_type, counted_spans_policy_id, normalization_policy_id, estimate_or_exact and counted span list match
redaction_policy_id/version, private refs, redacted refs, content hashes and redaction_status are present and consistent

adaptive row names exact adaptive_target_locator_ref, adaptive_model_manifest_ref, user_local_checkpoint_id or target_checkpoint_id, fresh_load_ref and shares target locator mode except adaptive variable
quality_non_regression_status is PASS for the same pair_id and quality_comparison_ref is present; FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE/NOT_RUN blocks savings
token-accounting-report.json contains pair refs, counted spans, totals, comparison method, thresholds and repeated-run variance policy
baseline row has model_mode=common_baseline, adaptive_enabled=false, user_local_checkpoint_id=null and no adaptive artifact reads

failure_label_catalog.label: MISMATCH_HOST
failure_label_catalog.use_when: Baseline and adaptive rows do not have the same host_name, host_type, host_runtime_surface, host_runtime_version, adapter_version, host_entrypoint, or live scope.

failure_label_catalog.label: MISMATCH_PROMPT
failure_label_catalog.use_when: scenario_id, pair_id, canonical_prompt_text_sha256, task_id, expected_answer_contract, privacy_class, or source_split_id differ.

failure_label_catalog.label: MISMATCH_METHOD
failure_label_catalog.use_when: method, debug_enabled, invocation_options_hash_sha256, counted pipeline step, or scenario method differs.

failure_label_catalog.label: MISMATCH_EVIDENCE_CLASS
failure_label_catalog.use_when: evidence_classification or live_scope differs, or helper/dashboard/API/handler evidence is used as live host token-savings evidence.
failure_label_catalog.effect: pairing_integrity_status=FAIL; token_savings_claim_allowed=false; scoped evidence may remain diagnostics only

failure_label_catalog.label: MISMATCH_TOKENIZER_ACCOUNTING
failure_label_catalog.use_when: tokenizer_name, tokenizer_version, tokenizer_accounting_type, accounting_version, counted_spans_policy_id, estimate_or_exact, normalization_policy_id, or token_count fields differ in method or scope.

failure_label_catalog.label: MISMATCH_REDACTION
failure_label_catalog.use_when: redaction_policy_id, redaction_policy_version, raw/private refs, redacted refs, prompt/output hashes, or redaction_status are missing or inconsistent.

failure_label_catalog.label: MISMATCH_ADAPTIVE_REF
failure_label_catalog.use_when: Adaptive row lacks exact user_local_checkpoint_id, target_checkpoint_id, adaptive_model_manifest_ref, adaptive_target_locator_ref, fresh_load_ref, or differs outside the explicit baseline/adaptive variable.

failure_label_catalog.label: QUALITY_PREREQ_NOT_PASSED
failure_label_catalog.use_when: quality_comparison_ref for the same pair_id is missing, inconclusive, mixed-class, not PASS, or shows adaptive quality regression.
failure_label_catalog.effect: token_savings_claim_allowed=false even if adaptive token count is lower

failure_label_catalog.label: MISSING_TOKEN_ACCOUNTING_REPORT
failure_label_catalog.use_when: No token accounting report records counted spans, tokenizer/accounting version, pair id, baseline/adaptive refs, thresholds, repeated-run policy, and variance handling.

failure_label_catalog.label: MISSING_BASELINE_COMMON_NO_ADAPTIVE_REF
failure_label_catalog.use_when: Baseline row does not prove common/no-adaptive isolation or contains adaptive artifact reads.

pass_conditions_for_future_capture_packe.note: A capture packet can pass as capture evidence while still keeping savings closed. Savings requires later token-delta report plus same-pair quality non-regression PASS.

what_is_not_enough: A token count decrease without same-pair quality non-regression PASS.
Dashboard/API/helper/handler/package-smoke trace used as live host savings evidence.
Historical baseline/adaptive traces not tied to current TOKEN-01 pair_id and evidence class.
Adaptive run without exact user-local checkpoint, target checkpoint, manifest and fresh-load refs.
Different tokenizer/accounting versions or heuristic/exact accounting mixed inside one pair.
Redacted summary without private evidence refs and committed redacted refs/hashes.
